q: What exactly is this kit, and what do I get when I clone it?
a: This kit is a reactive full-stack TALL stack application combining Laravel 12, Livewire 4, and PostgreSQL 16. You get a pre-wired Docker Compose container setup, 6 AI agent rule dialects, 5 operational skills, automated architectural tests, and a reactive real-time Task Manager component.

q: Which versions does it pin, and why those?
a: It pins PHP 8.4+, Laravel 12, Livewire 4, and PostgreSQL 16+. These versions deliver native UUID support, single-file Volt components, morphdom diffing, and long-term security support.

q: Which AI coding agents are supported, and how do the rules reach each one?
a: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cline, and Antigravity are supported via transpiled native dialect targets generated from canonical source rules.

q: What do I need installed before I start?
a: You only need Docker Engine 24+ and Docker Compose v2.20+. All runtime dependencies (PHP 8.4, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, Composer) run inside isolated containers.

q: How long does installation take, honestly, and what can slow it down?
a: A fresh install takes between 60 to 90 seconds on a standard broadband connection. Primary bottleneck is pulling base Alpine container images.

q: Is the starter production-shaped or a demo? What must I change before real production?
a: The starter is production-shaped with strict security defaults. Before production release, rotate default database credentials, set APP_DEBUG=false, generate a unique APP_KEY, and configure SSL termination.

q: How is security handled in this kit, and where are its checks?
a: Security is enforced at multiple layers: Argon2id password hashing, component property checksum validation, BOLA authorization policies, and automated secret scanning. The complete 12-control suite is in security/checks.json.

q: Can I change the design? Where do the design tokens live?
a: Yes. Design tokens are documented in DESIGN.md. You can customize Tailwind CSS classes directly in Blade layouts and Flux UI components.

q: How do I update when a new kit version releases?
a: Review the CHANGELOG.md and merge updates to rules/ and skills/. Project-specific models, views, and .env settings remain untouched.

q: Can I use it for commercial and client work?
a: Yes. The kit is licensed under the permissive MIT License with zero royalties.

q: How do I contribute a fix or a skill back?
a: Submit a PR to https://github.com/Umar-444/Techtalks-stack-kits adhering to the 18-checkpoint completeness standard.

q: Where do I get help or report a problem?
a: Open an issue on the repository or participate in community discussions at https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com.

q: How does Livewire 4 prevent parameter tampering?
a: Livewire signs all public component properties with an HMAC checksum on every request. Any client-side DOM tampering causes an immediate checksum mismatch exception.

q: Why does this kit use PostgreSQL instead of MySQL?
a: PostgreSQL provides native UUID generation functions, robust JSONB querying with GIN indexing, and superior connection pooling under high concurrent Livewire event traffic.
